newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopia threatens to evict embassies on rent arrears.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopia threatens to evict embassies on rent arrears.

text.p: The Ethiopian agency that administers state-owned houses in Addis Ababa on Wednesday threatened to cancel rental contracts and evict 15 African embassies with a total rent arrears of more than $3 million.

The Agency for the Administration of Rental Houses said Gabon owed $423,985, Guinea $348,275, Sudan $331,131 and Niger $302,846. It said Tanzania, Equatorial Guinea, Congo and Sierra Leone each owed between $314,569 and $166,565.
Other African embassies in rent arrears included Mali, Uganda, Chad, Mozambique, Burundi and Zaire, the agency said.

"Unless they settle their long-standing arrears in the shortest possible time, the agency will be forced to sever power, water and telephone services and later terminate their rent contracts -- which will be followed by eviction orders," the agency said.
The agency did not define "shortest time possible".
